purpose: Screen 12 independent neutral front-3/4 hero concepts to separate generator variance from art-direction quality before full Base Character Round development.
constraints: approximately identical framing and visual scale

candidates.capybara_recognition: High; animal anatomy, low stance, small ears, and blunt muzzle read clearly as capybara-derived.
candidates.silhouette: Low compact loaf with rounded back and integrated head/body mass.
candidates.head_muzzle_identity: Large rounded muzzle is strong and capybara-specific, with simple nostril and mouth treatment.
candidates.body_proportion: Very low and heavy; body mass dominates with short grounded limbs.
candidates.eye_face_potential: Simple bead eye is printable and calm but has limited expression range.
candidates.distinctiveness: Moderate; clear animal read, but could drift into generic realistic capybara collectible.
candidates.apparent_fdm_risk: Low to moderate; toe separations, nostril recesses, and ear cavities need printability checks.
candidates.ownable_visual_hook: Large soft muzzle attached to a grounded loaf body.
candidates.weakest_feature: May be too naturalistic and not proprietary enough without a stronger silhouette rule.
candidates.drift_risks: Generic capybara figurine, plush-like realism, limited role flexibility.

candidates.capybara_recognition: High; low body, capybara muzzle, and animal stance are clear.
candidates.silhouette: Compact loaf silhouette with slightly more modeled head and eye detail than A1.
candidates.head_muzzle_identity: Muzzle and nostrils are strong; eye socket introduces more facial identity.
candidates.body_proportion: Low heavy body with short limbs and broad rear mass.
candidates.eye_face_potential: More expressive than A1 because of the eye rim, but still restrained.
candidates.distinctiveness: Moderate; eye/muzzle treatment is more memorable, but surface realism reduces toy clarity.
candidates.apparent_fdm_risk: Moderate; subtle surface texture, eye rim, nostril recesses, and toe grooves may need simplification.
candidates.ownable_visual_hook: Loaf body plus raised almond eye pocket.
candidates.strongest_feature: Best facial definition within the Grounded Loaf set.
candidates.weakest_feature: Surface noise and semi-realistic eye treatment conflict with clean prototype-form comparison.
candidates.drift_risks: Naturalistic capybara, fur-like surface treatment, less controlled manufacturing language.

candidates.capybara_recognition: High; capybara-derived head, muzzle, ears, and body are clear.
candidates.silhouette: More upright and legged than the intended low loaf direction.
candidates.head_muzzle_identity: Strong capybara muzzle with readable nostrils and soft mouth break.
candidates.body_proportion: Animal body remains heavy, but taller legs reduce the compact loaf feel.
candidates.eye_face_potential: Small natural eye reads calm but may not scale expression well.
candidates.distinctiveness: Moderate; believable and appealing but less stylized.
candidates.apparent_fdm_risk: Moderate; taller separated limbs and toe grooves introduce more overhang/fragility questions.
candidates.ownable_visual_hook: Arched capybara back with oversized blunt muzzle.
candidates.strongest_feature: Strong animal anatomy and stable body mass.
candidates.weakest_feature: Drifts away from the low compact premise.
candidates.drift_risks: Realistic toy animal, loss of loaf identity, less costume-zone clarity.

candidates.capybara_recognition: Moderate; muzzle suggests capybara, but upright mascot anatomy weakens animal specificity.
candidates.silhouette: Large head, rounded belly, hanging arms, and short feet create a classic designer-toy outline.
candidates.head_muzzle_identity: Big muzzle is readable, though the head shape risks bear or hippo drift.
candidates.body_proportion: Strong head/body separation with upright biped proportions.
candidates.eye_face_potential: Simple eye construction leaves room for expression tests.
candidates.distinctiveness: Moderate; clean toy language but currently close to generic mascot form.
candidates.apparent_fdm_risk: Moderate; arms, feet, and head/body shelf need support-free review.
candidates.ownable_visual_hook: Blocky rounded capybara snout on an upright toy body.
candidates.strongest_feature: High future costume and expression capacity.
candidates.drift_risks: Bear mascot, chibi mascot, humanized body language.

candidates.capybara_recognition: Moderate to high; muzzle and ears read capybara, but body language is mascot-first.
candidates.silhouette: Tall rounded head over simple cylindrical torso with drooping arms.
candidates.head_muzzle_identity: Muzzle has strong projection and nostril placement; cheek/mouth line is clean.
candidates.body_proportion: Iconic toy proportions with heavy head, smaller torso, and sturdy legs.
candidates.eye_face_potential: Simple circular eye is FDM-friendly but may be emotionally narrow without brow/mouth rules.
candidates.distinctiveness: Moderate; appealing but still near common vinyl/designer toy grammar.
candidates.apparent_fdm_risk: Moderate; arm-body separation and neck shadow may need support-aware modeling.
candidates.ownable_visual_hook: Oversized capybara head with soft upright body and short pillar legs.
candidates.drift_risks: Teddy bear/chibi drift, reduced animal stance, costume-first identity.

candidates.capybara_recognition: Moderate; muzzle helps, but the large round head and upright body push toward generic mascot.
candidates.silhouette: Very top-heavy, clean, and toy-like with simple arms and feet.
candidates.head_muzzle_identity: Muzzle is large and capybara-like, but ears and head dome feel broad and generic.
candidates.body_proportion: Strong head/body split; sturdy but less animal-derived.
candidates.eye_face_potential: Small blank eyes are simple but may lack character unless later expression rules are strong.
candidates.distinctiveness: Low to moderate; polished but familiar.
candidates.apparent_fdm_risk: Moderate; head overhang and limb separation need DFM review.
candidates.ownable_visual_hook: Giant soft muzzle under a dome head.
candidates.weakest_feature: Least capybara-specific of the B set.
candidates.drift_risks: Generic mascot, bear/hippo drift, identity depending on future costume.

candidates.direction: C - Expressive Stylized Character / Game-Character Language
candidates.capybara_recognition: Moderate; muzzle and ears remain capybara-derived, but the upright body overlaps with mascot language.
candidates.silhouette: Upright, broad, and sturdy with a more assertive head angle.
candidates.head_muzzle_identity: Muzzle is strong; narrowed eye area creates a more character-driven face.
candidates.body_proportion: Large torso and short limbs support game-character presence.
candidates.eye_face_potential: Good expression potential through eyelid/brow geometry without oversized anime eyes.
candidates.distinctiveness: Moderate; direction energy is visible but not far enough from B yet.
candidates.apparent_fdm_risk: Moderate; eyelid pocket, brow mass, and arm gaps require DFM checks.
candidates.ownable_visual_hook: Serious narrowed-eye capybara face on a stout upright body.
candidates.weakest_feature: May not be materially distinct enough from Designer Toy Mascot.
candidates.drift_risks: Mascot overlap, stern expression becoming the identity, reduced animal stance.

candidates.direction: C - Expressive Stylized Character / Game-Character Language
candidates.capybara_recognition: Moderate to high; muzzle and body remain readable, though facial stylization dominates.
candidates.silhouette: Upright rounded toy silhouette with added brow/face emphasis.
candidates.head_muzzle_identity: Large muzzle is clear; eyebrow and eye socket create stronger character hierarchy.
candidates.body_proportion: Rounded body, short legs, and hanging arms remain sturdy.
candidates.eye_face_potential: High; eyebrow and eye pocket suggest broader expression range.
candidates.distinctiveness: Moderate; face has more personality than B but still uses familiar mascot structure.
candidates.apparent_fdm_risk: Moderate; brow and eye pocket likely printable if thickened, but must avoid fragile relief.
candidates.ownable_visual_hook: Single raised soft brow over a large capybara muzzle.
candidates.strongest_feature: Most expressive neutral face in the C set.
candidates.weakest_feature: Neutral expression may already read as styled/cute rather than truly neutral.
candidates.drift_risks: Cartoon eyebrow overuse, generic cute mascot, face carrying identity more than silhouette.

candidates.direction: C - Expressive Stylized Character / Game-Character Language
candidates.capybara_recognition: Moderate; muzzle remains capybara-like, but head spikes and side planes weaken the base animal read.
candidates.silhouette: More dynamic and jagged than other candidates, with head crest and cheek spikes.
candidates.head_muzzle_identity: Muzzle is clear, but hairstyle-like top and cheek forms conflict with the prompt boundary.
candidates.body_proportion: Upright character body with more separated arms and hand detail.
candidates.eye_face_potential: High but risky; eye shape and crest push toward prohibited character tropes.
candidates.distinctiveness: High visual differentiation, but much of it comes from forbidden drift elements.
candidates.apparent_fdm_risk: High; head crest, cheek spikes, finger separations, and arm gaps create fragile/support concerns.
candidates.ownable_visual_hook: Angular cheek/head crest silhouette, though this may be a do-not-copy drift signal.
candidates.strongest_feature: Strongest visual energy and silhouette contrast.
candidates.weakest_feature: Violates or approaches prohibited hair/anime/game-mascot drift.
candidates.drift_risks: Hair/anime hairstyle language, generic game mascot, fragile protrusions, reduced capybara purity.

candidates.capybara_recognition: High; quadruped form, broad muzzle, ears, and body mass read capybara-derived.
candidates.silhouette: Planar quadruped silhouette with defined muzzle wedge, chest planes, and rounded rear mass.
candidates.head_muzzle_identity: Faceted muzzle and forehead plane create a strong sculptural identity.
candidates.body_proportion: Animal-derived with taller legs than A but robust overall mass.
candidates.eye_face_potential: Moderate; sculpted eye pocket is expressive but restrained.
candidates.distinctiveness: High; planar surface treatment makes it feel less generic.
candidates.apparent_fdm_risk: Moderate; leg separations and underside gaps need support-free analysis.
candidates.ownable_visual_hook: Faceted wedge muzzle with deliberate chest and shoulder planes.
candidates.weakest_feature: Less soft/cute than A or B.
candidates.drift_risks: Becoming too serious, losing emotional warmth, quadruped accessory limitations.

candidates.capybara_recognition: High; muzzle, ears, and body posture remain clearly capybara-derived.
candidates.silhouette: Softer sculptural quadruped with cleaner planes and rounded rear volume.
candidates.head_muzzle_identity: Strong front muzzle mass with restrained planes and readable nostril placement.
candidates.body_proportion: Balanced animal stance with sturdy legs and broad torso.
candidates.eye_face_potential: Moderate; eye socket supports controlled expression but may be subtler than mascot lanes.
candidates.distinctiveness: High; art-toy surface planes give a memorable premium read.
candidates.apparent_fdm_risk: Moderate; legs and underside need orientation planning, but planes are manufacturing-friendly.
candidates.ownable_visual_hook: Soft low-poly capybara planes over a chunky collectible body.
candidates.strongest_feature: Best balance of capybara recognition and sculptural restraint in the D set.
candidates.drift_risks: Premium sculpture becoming too restrained, limited expression/costume range.

candidates.capybara_recognition: High; broad muzzle, ears, stance, and body mass remain capybara-derived.
candidates.silhouette: Monolithic, angular-soft quadruped with broad muzzle block and simplified planes.
candidates.head_muzzle_identity: Very strong wedge muzzle and vertical split line create a clear face architecture.
candidates.body_proportion: Stout animal body with stable legs and rounded rear volume.
candidates.eye_face_potential: Low to moderate; eye is minimal and expression may be harder to scale.
candidates.distinctiveness: High; strong sculpture-first language and reduced noise.
candidates.apparent_fdm_risk: Moderate; leg gaps and eye recess require checks, but broad forms are favorable.
candidates.ownable_visual_hook: Large faceted muzzle mask over a monolithic capybara body.
candidates.drift_risks: Too static, less cute, role/costume additions may clash with clean planes.

human_decision_required: select which Round 0 candidates proceed to Base Character Round development
reject drifted candidates while preserving them as evidence
do not choose a final CAPICAPI master from Round 0 alone
